**Stable ID:** `DATA` · **Record type:** Program · **Workstream:** Program

Establish and run evidence-backed research on AI datasets and benchmarks: identity, versions, rights, provenance, evaluation integrity and integration with existing Pick Your AI research and consumers.

Coordinating parent: https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/issues/509

## Native children

- `DATA-01` Scope, taxonomy and governance
- `DATA-02` Dataset discovery and source inventory
- `DATA-03` Modality coverage
- `DATA-04` Dataset identity, versions and relationships
- `DATA-05` Licensing, access, consent and rights
- `DATA-06` Provenance, quality, bias and reproducibility
- `DATA-07` Benchmark datasets and grading semantics
- `DATA-08` Evaluation integrity and comparability
- `DATA-09` Metadata storage, manifests and recovery
- `DATA-10` Cross-repository integration
- `DATA-11` Search, directory and consumer experience
- `DATA-12` Contribution, freshness and maintenance

## Deliverables

- Twelve epics with accepted work packages
- Coverage ledger and decision register
- Accepted handoffs to research, catalog pipeline, papers, applications and website

- `README.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- All factual records cite public sources with access dates; synthetic fixtures stay in tests/

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every epic satisfies its own acceptance
- [ ] Coverage is reported against declared denominators
- [ ] No restricted dataset content is stored in the repository

## Non-goals

- Hosting or redistributing dataset contents
- Running benchmarks or reporting model scores
- Changing the frozen T0-T6 builder contract

## Dependencies

- No prerequisite work packages.

## Review requirements

- Research lead maintainer
- Independent dataset research reviewer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.

- Inbound: `Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research` — Coordinating parent research #509
